selectedPattern: Pattern B — App Service + Azure Function App
reason: The actual Financial runtime is already implemented as Azure Functions-compatible HTTP handlers with function.json triggers. Retaining that model as an intentional Azure Function App backend preserves behavior with less rewrite risk than porting five sensitive pilot/privacy endpoints into Next.js route handlers.
requirements: Financial frontend served by app-jm1-fin-prod App Service
Financial API handlers hosted on an intentional Azure Function App or equivalent Microsoft-native functions backend
App Service rewrites/proxy or frontend API base configuration must route /api/* calls without preserving SWA as a hidden permanent backend
Secrets remain server-side in App Service/Function App settings
Customer Voice feedback privacy rejection preserved
blocker: Capacity purchase decision must be resolved before production cutover; separate Function App creation may also have recurring-cost/architecture approval implications.
